top.line: When a data platform meets a site factory, every idea becomes a site in minutes.

in-short.line: IPMA six ways in twelve minutes; an invented holiday-homes company with real weather and events; demos.

ipma.line: ipma-data live at 10:48, twelve minutes after the ask, in six designs.

demos.para: Each a demo of a cell.

limits.line: Demos labelled; data as fresh as its last read; cameras linked not shown.

sources.line: The demo sites and the factory's request records.
